name: Puskesmas community health center
description: Free dengue testing and treatment. 10,000+ Puskesmas nationwide. First point of care for suspected dengue — no appointment needed.
tags: dengue clinic free treatment indonesia puskesmas testing fever walk-in

name: RSUD district hospital dengue ward
description: Public district hospitals with dengue wards for severe cases. Subsidized via BPJS health insurance for low-income patients.
contact: RSUD nearest district — bring BPJS card if available
tags: dengue hospital severe indonesia BPJS public subsidized ward hemorrhagic

name: National health emergency hotline
description: 24-hour hotline for health emergencies. Directs to nearest facility and can trigger district response.
tags: emergency hotline indonesia dengue 119 24hour urgent call

name: PMI Indonesian Red Cross — CP3 program
description: Community volunteers trained in early dengue detection and referral. Active in Pandeglang, Surakarta, and other endemic districts. Provides free ORS kits. Funded by USAID.
tags: red cross PMI ngo free ORS rehydration volunteer community surveillance early detection USAID

name: World Mosquito Program — Wolbachia Indonesia
description: Active in Yogyakarta, Sleman, Bantul, Denpasar, Buleleng. Wolbachia mosquitoes reduced dengue incidence by 77% in treated areas. Government target: zero dengue deaths by 2030.
tags: wolbachia prevention indonesia yogyakarta bali dengue 77% reduction program community

name: 3M-Plus Program — Ministry of Health
description: Drain water containers, cover water storage, recycle items collecting water. Plus: repellent, long clothes, bed nets. Government-endorsed household prevention.
tags: 3M program prevention indonesia government household drain cover recycle repellent nets

name: QDENGA dengue vaccine — school program
description: Indonesia rolling out Takeda QDENGA vaccine in schools targeting children. Government goal: reduce severe dengue cases nationally.
tags: vaccine dengue QDENGA indonesia children school prevention Takeda

name: BPNT food assistance program
description: Government food assistance for low-income households during extended illness. Register via Kelurahan (sub-district office) with KTP and KK documents.
tags: food assistance indonesia BPNT low income government recovery illness vulnerable
